description.message: Checks your local selection only when you ask.

consequence.message: Odina will read one suspicious file in the selection to verify its fingerprint locally. Nothing will be changed.

confirmed.message: Odina found a confirmed threat in the selection.

limits.message: This check did not block execution or move the file. A quarantine store is not available yet.

stillSuspect.message: The scan did not confirm an infection. The file is unchanged.
